title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE, KODRA E DIELLIT
description_sq:
Apartamenti 2+1 ndodhet në katin e katert, një pallat te mireadministruar në zonën Kodra e Diellit. 
Zone mjaft e kerkuar, me akses mjaft te lehte.
 Apartamenti ka sipërfaqe 96.5 m²
Eshte i strukturuar ne:
 • Korridor shperndares,
 • Ambient ndenje dhe gatimi,
 • 2 Dhoma gjumi,
 • Tualet,
 • Ballkon.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Pjese e nje ndertimi te ri, mjaft cilesor.
Apartamenti edhe ideal për banim, poe edhe per investim.
 Per me teper informacion, mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE, KODRA E DIELLI
description_en: The 2+1 apartment is located on the fourth floor, a well-managed building in Kodra e Diellit area. Very sought-after area, with easy access. The apartment has an area of ​​96.5 m². It is structured in: • distribution corridor, • living room and kitchen, • 2 bedrooms, • toilets, • balcony. Has regular mortgage documentation. Part of a new construction, very high quality. The apartment is ideal for living, but also for investment. For more information, do not hesitate to contact us.
